plainText:
Arven's Mabosstiff (Japanese: ペパーのマフィティフ Peper's Mafitiff) is a and a character in . It is Arven's best friend, who's been with him while his parents were away and the reason Arven went after the Herba Mystica.

==In the core series games==
===History===
====Background====
Mabosstiff was with Arven since it was a and Arven was a kid, both living in Poco Path's lighthouse alongside Professor Sada /Professor Turo . At one point, Arven's parent left them to go back to their research on Area Zero's Zero Lab, leaving both Arven and Maschiff to take care of themselves, which greatly strengthened their bonds, since Maschiff was everything Arven had left. At some point, Maschiff evolved into a Mabosstiff.

Sometime prior to the events of Scarlet and Violet, Arven and Mabosstiff tried to go down Area Zero to see his parent; however, they were attacked by an unknown Pokémon, greatly injuring Mabosstiff. After leaving the crater, Arven tried to heal Mabosstiff with potions and at the Pokémon Center, but nothing worked, forcing him to go after the Herba Mystica as described in the Scarlet Book /Violet Book .

==== ====
=====Path of Legends=====
After defeating the second Titan Pokémon, Arven finally reveals to the that he wanted to find the Herba Mystica to heal the wounds that Mabosstiff had received in Area Zero. As the duo defeated the Titans , , , / , and , they obtained the Sweet, Bitter, Salty, Sour, and Spicy Herba Mystica, allowing Arven to make es with each of them to help his wounded Mabosstiff recover from its injuries. After it ate all five of them, Mabosstiff finally makes a full recovery. After Sada /Turo asked the player's help in Area Zero, Arven decided to come along and used Mabosstiff in a battle for the first time in the game to make sure they're ready.

=====The Way Home=====
Arven used Mabosstiff during their battles against the Paradox Pokémon in Area Zero.

=====Mochi Mayhem=====
When Arven was brainwashed by 's Binding Mochi, he used Mabosstiff to battle Kieran and the alongside Penny.

===Personality and characteristics===
 
Mabosstiff took care of Arven back in Poco Path lighthouse when his parents weren't around to do so, growing to be Arven's best and only friend.

===In battle===
Arven will begin using Mabosstiff after it had fully recovered at the end of "Path of Legends". Mabosstiff will always be sent out last and be stallized by Arven at the first opportunity. However, during Multi Battles, Mabosstiff will always be sent out first and will not be Terastalized.

Mabossiff uses the same moveset in all of his battles, with his level varying:

Level 63 during the second battle with Arven in Poco Path and during Multi Battles in Area Zero.
Level 68 during the 's first challenge in the Academy Ace Tournament and every subsquent challenge until The Indigo Disk is completed.
Level 76 after completing The Indigo Disk and winning the Academy Ace Tournament for the first time, as an opponent in the Academy Ace Tournament (prior to Mochi Mayhem).
Level 83 during Mochi Mayhem and all subsequent battles in the Academy Ace Tournament and Blueberry Academy's League Club Room.

 

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Mabosstiff appears alongside its Trainer in as a sync pair.
 
 

==In the manga==

===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
 owned Mabosstiff since it was a . Some time before the events of the Scarlet & Violet arc, Mabosstiff suffered injuries that couldn't be healed by conventional methods. Arven decided to search for the Herba Mystica, hoping they could cure Mabosstiff's condition. It debuted in Discover! The Quaking Earth Titan!!, where Arven showed it inside its Poké Ball really weakened. In order to catch a Pokémon to help take down the Titan Pokémon guarding the Herba Mystica, Arven reluctantly traded Mabosstiff to Violet for a . He then caught a and used her to trade back for his partner.

As Arven and Violet defeated the Titan , , , , and , Mabosstiff started to regain its strength after eating the Sweet, Bitter, Salty, and Sour Herba Mystica es that Arven made for it.

 Right after defeating the fake Titan and making a sandwich out of the Spicy Herba Mystica, the real Titan showed up to stop them. Mabosstiff stepped up and scared it away, proving it had regained its strength.
 

==In the TCG==
This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Arven's Mabosstiff in the Pokémon Trading Card Game.

 
 
 
 
 
 

Mabosstiff also makes an appearance on the and from .

===Merchandise===
====Hot Wind Arena Sealed Battle====
Hot Wind Arena Sealed Battles (Japanese: シールド戦 熱風のアリーナ) began to be held at participating Pokémon Card Gym sites on March 14, 2025, coinciding with the launch of the subset. Locations typically charged for entry into these events, with an MRSP of ¥2,700 including tax. Entrants would receive 15 Hot Wind Arena booster packs and two participation prizes, which comprised one of two possible promotional prints of Nemona and a Paper Deck Case (Japanese: 紙製デッキケース) featuring Atsushi Furusawa artwork of Ethan and his , Cynthia and her , as well as Arven and his .

Promotional cards:
(SV-P Promo 256)

Product image:
 

====SV9a accessories====
A wave of TCG accessories complemented the subset on March 14, 2025. Like the Battle Partners expansion, a number of products depicted the Pokémon Trainers that featured in the subset. All items were exclusive to Pokémon Centers and the Pokémon Center Online, with the look to possibly make them available at Pokémon Stores and on Pokémon storefront at a later date.

The Arven & Mabosstiff Sleeves (Japanese: デッキシールド ペパー＆マフィティフ Deck Shield: Peper & Mafitiff) feature rival character Arven enjoying a picnic with his and . These sleeves were illustrated by MINAMINAMI Take. 
The Ethan & Typhlosion Sleeves (Japanese: デッキシールド ヒビキ＆バクフーン Deck Shield: Hibiki & Bakphoon) feature player character Ethan, his , and his . The autumnal scene by Oku also features the Bell Tower in the background.

Sleeve images:
 

==Trivia==
Arven is shown with a in Battle Studies classes, despite Mabosstiff already being fully evolved prior to the beginning of the game. After completing Path of Legends, Arven instead uses his Mabosstiff during Battle Studies classes. Its relation to Arven's Mabosstiff is unknown.
